opportunities.title: Synthesis grants

amount.raw: Synthesis groups can claim up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Main applicant must have BES membership; groups of 8-15 individuals with diverse mix of career stages, institutions and international participation.
opportunities.summary: Funds the formation of new two-year synthesis groups that bring together diverse interdisciplinary groups to focus on data analysis and synthesis, fostering collaboration and mentoring.

opportunities.title: Long-term research grants

amount.raw: Claim the first five years' worth of funding in year 1, which is £3,500; in the sixth year you can claim an additional £3,500 (total £7,000 over 10 years).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to all types of ecologists including conservation practitioners, reserve managers, consultants and university academics; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Provides a small amount of funding each year for 10 years to enable existing short-term projects with 1-2 years of data to be funded into the long term, supporting long-term ecological studies anywhere in the world.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical research and development grants

amount.raw: Projects can be awarded up to £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to anyone involved in teaching ecology at any level, from early years to life-long learning; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Funds research informing teaching and learning practices that improve learners' experience and promote excellence in teaching ecology, including evidence-based practice, systematic reviews and dissemination of best practice.

opportunities.title: Connecting ecologists with other disciplines grants

amount.raw: Grant awards of up to £20,000 can be claimed from the applicant.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early career ecologists, established researchers or employees of other organisations; undergraduates and masters students not eligible; awarded to individuals.
opportunities.summary: Funds interdisciplinary placements (secondments) of up to 12 months that immerse an ecologist in another professional world (another discipline, NGO/charity, public sector, business) to build interdisciplinary skills.

opportunities.title: Small research grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to researchers from all countries globally; projects can be conducted anywhere in the world.
opportunities.summary: Supports new and innovative ecological research of the highest international standard, with a clear ecological science focus.

opportunities.title: Outreach and engagement grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must have BES membership; open to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels; no restrictions on where applicants come from or carry out work.
opportunities.summary: Supports BES members to deliver independent outreach, public engagement and science communication activities that engage public audiences with the excitement, importance and relevance of ecological science.

opportunities.title: Training and travel grants

amount.raw: A maximum of £250 is available to cover registration fees for virtual conferences/courses; a maximum of £500 is available for events in person.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member and a PhD student or postgraduate researcher (postdoc researchers, undergraduates and masters students not eligible); must work or study at a university or research institution.
opportunities.summary: Helps PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses and to network and publicise their research by presenting at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member at any career stage; must be a citizen of and based in the Global South; must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting; must be at least three years since last awarded a BES Training and Travel Grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting in the UK, covering travel, registration, food and accommodation costs.
